baseline_models.mechanism: The measuring branch of creation makes death and life a deliberately proportioned field; the testing branches then expose the quality of purposive action, while the effort-limit branch of أَحْسَنُ makes excellence rather than volume the criterion.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning supplies the design logic for a calibrated death-life field.
Testing that makes quality or defect appear supplies the assay function.
The alternate mapped inventory also supplies examination in good and bad, preserving the split-root evidence.
The image of one's utmost effort and limit sharpens أَحْسَنُ into performance at the agent's limit.
Purposive action identifies the measured output as intentional agency rather than mere occurrence.

changed_reading.before: Death and life are created so that people can be tested for good deeds.
changed_reading.after: Death and life form a calibrated assay that brings the quality of intentional agency, especially at its limit, into view; the criterion is excellence rather than sheer activity.

baseline_models.mechanism: The trial exposes conduct before an authority able to overpower, yet the closing name also supplies protective covering and protection from sin's consequence. Power makes accountability effective; forgiveness prevents the assay from implying automatic condemnation.

activation_trace.role: Manifesting actual quality supplies the accountable exposure between the two closing names.
Overpowering and subduing supply effective authority over the disclosed result.
Covering that protects supplies a sheltering function rather than simple concealment.
Covering sin and protecting its bearer from consequence specifies the merciful outcome available after exposure.

changed_reading.before: The divine names append a generic assurance after the test.
changed_reading.after: The names define the test's accountability logic: its results matter under irresistible authority, but exposed failure remains answerable by protective forgiveness.

baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of موت as deadened force and حياة as benefit allow the pair to describe an efficacy continuum as well as biological states. Joined to excellent action and putting something to use, the test asks how created capacity is converted into benefit rather than left inert.

activation_trace.role: Deadening or weakening force supplies the inert end of an efficacy continuum.
Life as benefit and good supplies the fruitful end of that continuum.
Excellent doing, mastery, and benefaction define the desired quality of efficacy.
Putting a thing to work supplies the conversion of available capacity into operative use.

changed_reading.before: The test occupies the biological interval between birth and death.
changed_reading.after: The test also tracks whether created capacity remains inert or is brought into excellent, beneficial operation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next two ayat turn created order into an object of repeated defect-search: disparity and fissure are specified as failure modes, the gaze is returned and repeated, and the inspector reaches exhaustion. This strengthens the calibrated-assay baseline into a stress test that survives reinspection.

activation_trace.role: Distance and disparity between things supply one explicit defect class for inspection.
Returning to a prior point supplies deliberate reinspection rather than a single glance.
Opening and splitting supply the second sought failure mode.
Return and repetition after an earlier pass make the inspection iterative.
Exhausted, cut-off strength marks the stress endpoint reached by the evaluator.

structural_cues: 67:3 orders vision to return after denying disparity and asks it to locate fissures.
67:4 repeats the return twice and ends with vision returned exhausted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: defect classes, repeated inspection, and evaluator fatigue. Reader arrow: I transfer that inspection pattern to the test of action, so best work is robust under reinspection. Alternative: the sequence may teach only the limits of perception rather than a quality standard for deeds.

changed_reading.before: The test is a one-time sorting of good from bad conduct.
changed_reading.after: The test is an iterative quality assay: excellent action is coherent enough to survive returned scrutiny, even as scrutiny exposes the evaluator's limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failed receptive hearing and reason become explicit self-confession, while concealed speech and inward content are already known by the Creator. The test therefore need not acquire missing information; it makes an inward response occur as attributable action and finally recognizable admission.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance make hearing an accountable reception, not bare acoustics.
Reason as a restraint on ignorance supplies a capacity whose nonuse becomes culpable.
Acknowledging and yielding supplies the endpoint of self-recognized result.
Hiding something inward supplies the supposedly inaccessible side of conduct.
Disclosure to the knower supplies knowledge already present at the level of the Creator.
Knowledge of the report and the matter's interior closes off an information-deficit model of testing.

structural_cues: 67:10-11 moves from unused hearing and reason to confession of the result.
67:13-14 moves from secret or voiced speech to the Creator's knowledge of what was created.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: failed capacities, confession, concealment, and prior inward knowledge. Reader arrow: the test actualizes and makes attributable what is already known rather than informing the Creator. Alternative: testing may still primarily name judgment or proof without emphasizing manifestation.

changed_reading.before: Testing discovers which people are best in action.
changed_reading.after: Testing gives already-known inward orientation an enacted, accountable form that agents can finally recognize and confess.

context_deltas.mechanism: Conduct under visual absence is paired directly with forgiveness and recompense. This makes the quality tested in 67:2 include integrity where ordinary surveillance is unavailable, and it converts الْغَفُورُ from a general closing name into an explicit outcome for that hidden posture.

activation_trace.role: Fear joined with awe supplies an inward regulator of conduct.
Concealment from eyes supplies the low-surveillance condition in which integrity is tested.
Protection from sin's consequence makes the focus epithet an explicit promised result.
Recompense for work supplies an outcome proportioned to unseen conduct.

structural_cues: 67:12 alone binds awe in the unseen condition to forgiveness and a great recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: awe, concealment from sight, forgiveness, and work-recompense. Reader arrow: I treat their pairing as a specification of what 'best in action' measures. Alternative: the ayah may describe one rewarded class without defining the whole test criterion.

changed_reading.before: Best action is publicly observable good performance.
changed_reading.after: Best action centrally includes self-regulated integrity when no human observer can verify it, with forgiveness and recompense built into the test's outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is made usable after difficulty, humans are told to move through it and consume apportioned nourishment, and resurrection closes the sequence. Life becomes an enabled traversal through a provisioned field, while death is not a terminal edge because return follows it.

activation_trace.role: Making something tractable after difficulty supplies the prepared terrain of the test.
Walking and movement supply embodied agency across that terrain.
Nourishing sustenance supplies the energy for movement as a received provision.
Reviving the dead after death supplies the return beyond the traversal's mortal boundary.

structural_cues: 67:15 sequences prepared earth, commanded movement, consumed provision, and resurrection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: tractable terrain, walking, nourishment, and post-death revival. Reader arrow: I read their sequence as the functional architecture of the death-life test. Alternative: the ayah may chiefly demonstrate dependence and resurrection rather than define action as traversal.

changed_reading.before: Life is simply the duration allowed for producing deeds before death.
changed_reading.after: Life is an enabled, provisioned traversal whose manner of use constitutes the deed, and death opens onto return rather than erasing the route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context compares two walkers while changing posture and route: one is cast face-down, the other internally upright on a straight road. Since the bare activity is shared, the comparison relocates أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا from activity alone to orientation, balance, and trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Overturning or dropping onto the face supplies disordered posture and obstructed travel.
Intrinsic straightness and completeness supply the alternative walker's integrated posture.
The straight road supplies sustained direction rather than an isolated successful step.

structural_cues: 67:22 repeats the same walking verb on both sides, while posture and path carry the contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: two walkers, opposite posture, and a straight road. Reader arrow: I map the comparison onto the quality term أَحْسَنُ in the focus, making orientation part of action's excellence. Alternative: the comparison may classify belief states without redescribing عمل generally.

changed_reading.before: The test scores discrete deeds by their individual goodness.
changed_reading.after: The test also evaluates the embodied orientation and sustained path that organize deeds; identical motion can differ radically by posture and direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Creator originates the agents and supplies hearing, sight, and inward fire-like hearts, then marks gratitude as scarce. The tested work is therefore not autonomous production but the visible effect produced when entrusted capacities are received and rightly used.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a thing into being supplies the origination of the tested agent.
Auditory reception supplies one entrusted input channel.
Visual perception supplies a second entrusted input channel.
The heart imagined as inward kindling supplies an active interior that can transform perception into response.
Sufficiency with little and the appearance of its effect supply gratitude as observable yield from received capacity.

structural_cues: 67:23 sequences origination, endowment with three faculties, and the scarcity of gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: originated agents, supplied faculties, and gratitude whose effect appears. Reader arrow: I identify right use and grateful yield as a mechanism of best action. Alternative: gratitude may be a separate response to creation rather than the focus test's comprehensive metric.

changed_reading.before: People independently supply the deeds by which they are tested.
changed_reading.after: The tested deed is the agent's response with endowed capacities: excellence appears as the right transformation of received perception and inward power into grateful effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sowing branch of dispersal across the earth and the branch of driving a group together toward a destination create an agricultural-spatial arc. Life can be carried as a scattering into a field, death as the turn toward collection, and work as what develops between sowing and gathering.

activation_trace.role: Sowing seed in earth supplies a material image for human dispersal into the testing field.
Driving and collecting a group toward one destination supplies the convergent endpoint.

structural_cues: 67:24 places dispersal on earth and gathering to God in one forward sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an earth-sowing branch and collection toward a destination. Reader arrow: I treat their ordered opposition as a lifecycle mechanism for the focus pair and infer growth between them. Alternative: ذَرَأَ may signify origination or multiplication without an agricultural implication here.

changed_reading.before: Death and life are two created states surrounding an individual test.
changed_reading.after: The pair can organize a collective sowing-to-gathering arc: agents are dispersed into the earthly field, their work develops there, and they are collected toward one destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split inventories around the promised event supply an appointed time-place, a counted duration, and an interval between years; its later rush into nearness changes faces. The test is therefore conducted under a real but deferred horizon whose unknown distance is part of the pressure.

activation_trace.role: An appointment bounded by time or place supplies a determinate endpoint despite unknown timing.
A counted waiting-duration supplies measurable deferral within the split mapping.
Time between years supplies a form-distant interval image that keeps the deferred span visible.
A rush into nearness supplies the reversal from deferred horizon to immediate encounter.

structural_cues: 67:25 asks when the promise is, while 67:27 presents it as suddenly near and affectively visible on faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: appointment, counted duration, interval, and sudden nearness. Reader arrow: I make deferred timing a pressure-bearing condition of the test. Alternative: the non-dominant mapped roots are form-distant, and the sequence may concern denial of resurrection more specifically than ordinary action under mortality.

changed_reading.before: Mortality supplies a finite but otherwise neutral deadline for action.
changed_reading.after: The hidden yet determinate appointment actively shapes the test: excellent action must orient itself under deferral before the horizon rushes into nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch already images life as earth revived by rain. The final ayah then contrasts familiar water with its descent into inaccessible depth and asks who can restore a running source. Death and life become materially legible as withdrawal and availability of a sustaining medium, making dependence part of the test.

activation_trace.role: Earth revived by rain anchors the final water mechanism directly in the focus word life.
Water in its ordinary sense supplies the concrete life-support medium at both occurrences.
Descent into depth supplies withdrawal from human reach without annihilating the substance.
A flowing spring supplies restored accessibility and continuing life.

structural_cues: 67:30 closes the surah with one resource moving from present possession to inaccessible depth, then contrasts it with flowing availability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: rain-revived life, ordinary water, descent, and a flowing spring. Reader arrow: I map accessibility to life and withdrawal to death-like loss, making dependence on provision a test condition. Alternative: the closing question may illustrate sovereignty over provision without semantically revising the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: Death removes life at the endpoint of an otherwise self-contained human career.
changed_reading.after: Life is continuously received as accessible support and death is imaged as its withdrawal beyond reach; action is tested inside that ongoing dependence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the worn-garment branch of خ ل ق and the wear branches of موت and ب ل و color a verbal creation statement. It remains anchored in four focus roots and gains coherence from life's rain-regrowth branch, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for testing through attrition and renewal, not as the lexical translation of خَلَقَ.

activation_trace.role: A garment worn smooth through use supplies a material image of created conditions weathering the agent.
Stillness, sleep, and wear supply phases of depletion rather than only a final biological event.
Rain and fresh growth supply renewal after depletion.
Wear and fraying make trial an attritional process that reveals what remains.
The alternate mapped wear branch confirms attrition across the split-root inventory.

changed_reading.before: Death and life are fixed endpoints within which testing occurs.
changed_reading.after: Death-like depletion and life-like regrowth can be carried as repeated weathering cycles through which the texture and endurance of action become visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 'best' normally suggests a maximum while the context says 'little' and the selected gratitude branch values a small input whose effect appears. It remains anchored in أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا and in the exact 67:23 contrast, but prose should frame it as a qualitative counterpoint to volume, not claim that أَحْسَنُ means small.

activation_trace.role: Utmost effort and limit make excellence a question of how fully one's available measure is realized.
Purposive action keeps the proposed yield anchored in the tested deed.
Littleness supplies the explicitly low quantity against which quality is tested.
Sufficing with little while making its effect visible supplies a high-yield model of gratitude.

changed_reading.before: Best work is imagined as the largest or most impressive output.
changed_reading.after: Best work may instead be the clearest right effect drawn from one's received measure, even when the quantitative output is small.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the death-life polarity onto contraction and extension within bird flight rather than onto chronological endpoints. It remains attached to the focus موت and حياة branches and to 67:19's exact spread-contract-hold sequence, but downstream prose should call it a kinetic analogy of sustained dependence, not an interpretation that equates death with every folded wing.

activation_trace.role: Weakening or deadening force supplies the contracted pole of the kinetic analogy.
The living creature supplies the active, extended pole in the bird image.
Contraction after expansion supplies an alternating pulse rather than a final closure.
A hold that preserves the last breath supplies continued life through the contracted phase.
Mercy and tenderness identify sustaining agency behind the alternating motion.

changed_reading.before: Life is a stable span terminated once by death.
changed_reading.after: Life can be imagined as repeatedly sustained through death-like contractions, with every renewed extension dependent on a merciful holding power.

strongest_changes: Repeated defect-search turns the focus test into an iterative quality and stress assay.
Confession plus prior knowledge revises testing from information acquisition to enacted manifestation and self-recognition.
Walking posture and endowed faculties relocate best action in sustained orientation and responsible use of received capacities.
The final water image materializes death and life as withdrawal and availability of continuing support.
summary.what_was_special: Material branches repeatedly converted abstract mortality into mechanisms: calibrated measurement, attritional wear, traversable terrain, sowing and gathering, contraction held in flight, and water descending beyond reach. These mechanisms preserve several coexisting senses of how action becomes visible.
remaining_uncertainties: The material readings may function as cross-domain analogies rather than contextual lexical force.
The packet leaves endurance, orientation, unseen integrity, gratitude, and beneficial efficacy as coexisting dimensions rather than one final definition of best action.
The alternate mappings for ب ل و and especially و ع د are retained for visibility, but their non-dominant branch contributions remain more exploratory than the primary mappings.
